headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: However, margins faced pressure due to a lag in passing on raw material cost inflation.
The management expects strong second-half profitability, maintaining its full-year plumbing EBITDA margin guidance of 16%–18% alongside a double-digit volume growth target of 290,000–300,000 MT.
Adhesives top-line growth guidance was upgraded to match the strong 25% H1 run rate.
Management projects full-year plumbing EBITDA near Rs 10,500 Mn, driven by higher volumes and an improved product mix.
valuation: The management expects strong second-half profitability, maintaining its full-year plumbing EBITDA margin guidance of 16%–18% alongside a double-digit volume growth target of 290,000–300,000 MT.

We maintain our earnings estimates for FY27E/FY28E and reiterate our BUY rating with an unchanged target price of Rs 1,714, assigning a 55x PER on FY28E.  Positive H2 Outlook: Astral expects a strong second half, fully offsetting Q2 inflation via CPVC and PVC price hikes.
Machinery installation is underway, with trials expected to conclude early in Q4 and commercial production targeted by late Q4 FY27.
watch: The recent Minimum Import Price implementation is expected to provide a stable floor for PVC prices, limiting channel inventory risks.
